title: Item vendors
summary: Set who supplies each item, by hand or from a spreadsheet. Reorder, New order, purchase orders and Fix Issues use the list.

blocks.text: Setup › **Item vendors** lists every item with its vendors. Use it when your POS has no vendor field, for example Clover.

items: Find the item with the search box, or choose **Without a vendor**.
Choose **Edit**, type the vendor (names you used before are suggested) and the vendor item code if you have one.
Add more vendors if needed and use the arrows to put the first choice on top. Choose **Save**.
Choose **Import CSV**, then **Download the template**, or **Export CSV** to start from your current list.
One row per item and vendor: Item ID (or Barcode, or Item name), Vendor, and optionally Vendor item code and Rank (1 = first choice).
Pick the file. RetailOps checks every row and shows the problems. Rows with a problem are skipped.
Choose **Apply**. An item's rows in the file replace its list.

blocks.text: Importing the same file again changes nothing, so it is safe to retry.

items: What you type or import here.
When your inventory file has a Supplier column, that column replaces the list for the items it names.
For a store whose inventory file always carries the vendors, this page is read-only: change vendors in the POS export and upload it again.
